author: gearashi
body:
Kryptos Research Workbench v0.6.0

All 90 requested proposals were implemented and evaluated.89 remain as optional methods, conditional models or supporting primitives; the restart portfolio is disabled following its negative comparison. Several retained methods tie older strategies or trade reduced search for more preparation/replay, so this is not 89 independent search-efficiency wins. See [all 90 outcomes](https://github.com/gearashi/KryptosSolverK4andK5/blob/v0.6.0/research/IMPROVEMENTS_Q.md).

The new Research methods panel exposes relation/SMT, factor, geometry/language/codebook and symbolic-recipe experiments with saved technique traces. Existing cipher searches gain optional propagation, bounds, decomposition and verified reuse.

Launch/setup repairs add HTTP readiness checks, automatic fallback from occupied ports, reuse of a matching local server, bounded CUDA probing and browser-failure recovery. Actual Windows batch setup and launch passed, including paths with spaces and CUDA_PATH unset.

Local clean-package validation: 539 Python tests passed; one optional raw-source audit skipped; 117 browser checks and 6 Node checks passed. Actual i7-4790/RTX2060 testing compared 196,608 timed candidate evaluations across all 8 CPU threads and CUDA configurations with identical certified top 20 results. GitHub CI separately validates CPU packages on Windows/Linux with Python 3.10/3.12.

Best tested family-scan settings for the tested computer:CUDA,  certified ranking, 1 worker, 8,192/page; CPU alternative 8 workers, 2,048/page. [Hardware settings and limits](https://github.com/gearashi/KryptosSolverK4andK5/blob/v0.6.0/docs/HARDWARE_SETTINGS.md).

Start with Setup.cmd (optionally -Gpu -Sat), then OpenDashboard.cmd. The app remains idle until an experiment is started. GPL-3.0-only; published through gearashi. This project has not authenticated a K4 or K5 solution.

Exact source: 23474de7bc0fd0adf9e168868cc01b001fc53a10. [Verified package workflow](https://github.com/gearashi/KryptosSolverK4andK5/actions/runs/40739234916).
